name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 65 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 39 hours starting 2025-12-02, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.69 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
